script.problem: It has 37 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.

terra.problem: “Stuck to Israel since Egypt” suggests the shame began in Egypt. The notes do not establish this for every explanation; the uncircumcised state and some taunts are connected with what happened after Israel left Egypt.
“Uncircumcised” and “taunts” may be hard for a 10-year-old. Briefly explain circumcision as a special mark God commanded for His people, and use simpler words for taunts.
